row.title: The Cloudflare adapter entry is built from a configuration
row.body: worker.js builds the Worker from a configuration so tests and other hosts do not need the rendered config.js; both schedulers share one guarded tick. Its tests cite US-03-R06 and US-03-R01 and the conformance manifest now records R06 as met.
